stability_object: 10D adiabatic quasi-steady M3 slow-flow eigenvalues; not full RF Lyapunov/Floquet exponents
stationary_balance_jacobian: finite-difference scaled 6x6 Jacobian with inner HB re-solved at each perturbation

reduced_slowflow.approximation: Quasi-steady frozen-torus M3 closure: micromotion is recomputed at each slow state; slow accelerations are omitted from the fast HB operator; Coulomb uses independent-phase ring averages. This is a local adiabatic averaged-flow model, not a full-system Floquet or Lyapunov spectrum.
